subject.title: [Feishu] 飞书群多机器人身份混乱问题

question: Which stable Feishu bot/account discriminator should be part of durable group session identity, and how should existing Feishu group session history be migrated or repaired?
rationale: The fix crosses a durable session-key, message-routing, and account-identity boundary; automation can identify the missing discriminator but cannot safely choose the compatibility and security tradeoff.

options.title: Account-scoped group sessions with migration
options.body: Include the normalized OpenClaw Feishu account boundary in group session identity and add doctor or migration handling for existing group keys.

options.title: Platform app or bot identity scope
options.body: Use a Feishu platform identity such as appId or another proven bot identity if maintainers prefer platform semantics over OpenClaw account ids.

options.title: Defer pending broader Feishu identity design
options.body: Keep this open while related Feishu multi-bot mention, context, and DM identity work converges on a shared model.

recommendation.title: Account-scoped group sessions with migration
recommendation.body: Include the normalized OpenClaw Feishu account boundary in group session identity and add doctor or migration handling for existing group keys.

likelyOwner.reason: They already reviewed the adjacent Feishu multi-bot identity PR and called out the current-main identity decision surface as non-mechanical.
